name: builder
wording: The agent that receives one task and hands over one pull request that passes every check; it may read the rest of the work, but of the meaning it sees only its task and its story's visible examples, and it never edits an example.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated. A builder receives a task and hands over a pull request; work packages are gone.
